-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $V='{{SpecificInstanceJavaVersion}}'; if ($V -eq 'auto') { if (@('1.7.10','1.12.2','1.16.5') -contains '{{MohistVersion}}') { $V='8' } else { $V='17' } }; Set-Location -Path 'mohist'; try { $Latest=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/'+$V+'/hotspot?architecture=x64&image_type=jdk&os=windows&vendor=eclipse'))[0].version.openjdk_version } catch { $Latest=$null }; if (-not $Latest) { Write-Output ('Could not look up Eclipse Temurin Java '+$V+'. Aborting'); exit 1 }; if ((Test-Path 'java\bin\java.exe') -and (Test-Path 'java\.temurin-version') -and ((Get-Content 'java\.temurin-version' -Raw).Trim() -eq $Latest)) { Write-Output ('Eclipse Temurin Java '+$Latest+' already installed. Skipping'); exit 0 }; if (Test-Path 'java.zip') { Remove-Item 'java.zip' -Force }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/'+$V+'/ga/windows/x64/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse') -OutFile 'java.zip' -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output 'Download failed from the Eclipse Temurin CDN. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path 'java-extract') { Remove-Item 'java-extract' -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive -Path 'java.zip' -DestinationPath 'java-extract' -Force; Remove-Item 'java.zip' -Force; $Dir=Get-ChildItem -Path 'java-extract' -Directory | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $Dir) { Write-Output 'The Java archive was empty. Aborting'; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path 'java') { Remove-Item 'java' -Recurse -Force }; Move-Item -Path $Dir.FullName -Destination 'java'; Remove-Item 'java-extract' -Recurse -Force; Set-Content -Path 'java\.temurin-version' -Value $Latest; Write-Output ('Eclipse Temurin Java '+$Latest+' downloaded')"
